# Plan: User Dashboard

## Context
Build a user dashboard that shows account stats, recent activity, and settings.

Surface mode (Pass 4 classifier): **OPERATE**. The visitor's win is "check my numbers, see what happened, change a setting, leave." App UI rules apply; no marketing hero.

## Implementation
1. Create a dashboard page at /dashboard with the layout in D1.
2. Show user stats (posts, followers, engagement rate) as the Stats strip per D1 and D3.
3. Add a recent activity feed per D1, D3, D5.
4. Add a settings panel per D8.
5. Apply the type and color tokens in D2 (replaces "clean, modern UI with cards and icons").
6. Replace the gradient hero with the Identity bar in D1 (hero removed; see Pass 4).
7. Implement every state in the D3 table and the D4 empty states.
8. Implement responsive layouts per D6 and accessibility per D7.

## Technical Details
- React components with Tailwind CSS (tokens from D2 exposed as CSS variables in `tailwind.config`)
- API endpoint: GET /api/dashboard
- WebSocket for real-time activity updates (behavior in D5)

## Design Decisions

Each decision is specified once here. Passes, tasks and the report refer to these IDs.

### D1. Information architecture (Pass 1)
Three things, in this order: **the numbers, what changed, where to act**. Everything else is subordinate.

```
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Logo]  Dashboard   Posts   Audience   Settings            [Avatar]  |  <- global nav, current page underlined
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Identity bar: "@handle · Last 30 days ▾"               [New post]    |  <- 1 line, 56px, flat surface, one accent button
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STATS STRIP (one row, hairline dividers, no cards)                   |
|  Posts 128  ▲4     Followers 2,310  ▲62     Engagement 4.8%  ▼0.3    |  <- tabular numerals, delta vs previous period
+------------------------------------------+---------------------------+
| RECENT ACTIVITY (primary workspace, 2/3) | SETTINGS (context, 1/3)   |
|  ● "Jane liked your post" · 2m           |  Email digest  [toggle]   |
|  ● "New follower: @sam" · 14m            |  Profile visibility [▾]   |
|  ● "Your post reached 1k" · 1h           |  Timezone [▾]             |
|  ...                                     |  Manage account →         |
|  [Show earlier activity]                 |                           |
+------------------------------------------+---------------------------+
```
Navigation flow: nav → /dashboard (default landing after login). Activity rows link to the referenced post or profile. "Manage account" links to the full settings route. The stats strip is not clickable (no hidden affordances).

### D2. Type and color tokens (Pass 5, replaces "clean, modern UI")
| Token | Value | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--font-ui` | IBM Plex Sans 400/600 | body and UI, 16px base, 1.5 line height |
| `--font-num` | IBM Plex Mono 500, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` | stats, deltas, timestamps |
| `--text-1` / `--text-2` | `#17191C` / `#5A6068` | primary / secondary text on `--surface` |
| `--surface` / `--surface-2` | `#FFFFFF` / `#F4F5F7` | page / settings column |
| `--accent` | `#0B6E4F` | one accent: primary button, focus ring, active nav |
| `--up` / `--down` | `#0B6E4F` / `#B42318` | deltas; always paired with ▲/▼ glyph, never color alone |
| `--hairline` | `#E3E5E8` 1px | dividers; no card borders, no shadows, no gradients |
| `--radius` | 6px (controls only) | containers are square |
| Type scale | 32/24/16/14 px | stat value / section heading / body / meta |
Browser surfaces themed from these tokens: selection `--accent` at 20% alpha, focus ring 2px `--accent` offset 2px, caret `--accent`. Light mode chosen because the use scene is a creator checking numbers at a desk or on a phone in daylight; see U2.

### D3. Interaction state table (Pass 2)
What the user SEES, per feature.

| FEATURE | LOADING | EMPTY | ERROR | SUCCESS | PARTIAL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stats strip | 3 skeleton bars at value height, labels visible, 200ms delay before showing | See D4-a | Values replaced by "—", one inline line: "Couldn't load stats. Retry" (button) | Values with ▲/▼ delta and period label | Loaded stats shown; missing stat shows "—" with tooltip "Not available yet" |
| Activity feed | 5 skeleton rows, 200ms delay | See D4-b | Inline notice at feed top: "Activity isn't loading. Retry"; last known rows stay visible | Rows newest first, relative time, each row one line, 47-char names truncated with ellipsis and full name in `title` | First page shown; "Show earlier activity" button; if an earlier page fails, the button shows "Retry loading earlier" |
| Live updates (WS) | Dot in feed heading: "Live" when connected | n/a | Heading dot goes gray: "Reconnecting…", then "Offline, refresh to update" after 30s | New items per D5 | Connected but no events: heading stays "Live", nothing else changes |
| Settings panel | Controls render disabled with current values grayed until loaded | n/a (always has settings) | Field-level: "Couldn't save. Try again" under the control, previous value restored | Control reflects new value, 2s "Saved" text next to it, no toast | One field fails, others saved; only the failed field shows its error |
| Identity bar / period picker | Handle shown immediately from session; period picker disabled until stats load | n/a | Picker stays on last good period; stats error shown in strip | Changing period reloads stats and feed with skeletons | n/a |

### D4. Empty states (Pass 2)
- **D4-a Stats, no posts yet:** values show "0", engagement shows "—". Under the strip, one sentence in `--text-2`: "Your stats start with your first post." Primary action is the existing New post button, which gains a 1-line caption; no illustration.
- **D4-b Feed, no activity:** feed area shows a single row-height line: "Nothing yet. When people follow or react, it shows up here." plus a secondary link "Share your profile" (copies URL). No icon, no empty-state artwork.
- **D4-c Feed, filtered period empty:** "No activity in the last 30 days. Show all time" (link switches period).

### D5. Live update behavior (Pass 2/3)
New WebSocket events do not insert into the list while the user is reading. A pill appears at feed top: "3 new · Show". Clicking inserts the rows with one 200ms ease-out fade (the page's single authored motion moment) and scrolls to the top of the feed. If the user is already scrolled to the top and idle for 5s, items insert directly. Stats strip values update in place without animation when the payload includes new totals.

### D6. Responsive behavior (Pass 6)
| Viewport | Layout decision |
|---|---|
| ≥1024px | D1 as drawn: 2/3 feed, 1/3 settings, stats in one row |
| 768–1023px | Stats one row; settings column moves below the feed as a full-width section headed "Settings"; feed shows 10 rows before "Show earlier" |
| <768px | Global nav collapses to bottom tab bar (Dashboard, Posts, Audience, Settings) at 56px; identity bar wraps to two lines with New post full-width below; stats become a 3-up single row with values at 24px and labels at 12px, horizontally fixed (no scroll); feed is the page body; settings panel is NOT shown inline, the Settings tab routes to the full settings page; live-update pill is sticky under the identity bar |
Touch targets 44×44px minimum on all viewports. Activity rows are 56px tall on <768px.

### D7. Accessibility (Pass 6)
- Landmarks: `header` (nav), `main` (stats + feed), `aside` (settings, labeled "Settings"), `nav` with `aria-current="page"`.
- Headings: h1 "Dashboard" visually hidden; h2 for Stats, Recent activity, Settings.
- Feed is `role="feed"` with `aria-busy` during loading; new items announced via `aria-live="polite"` region reading "3 new activity items" (not each item).
- Keyboard: Tab order follows D1 reading order; period picker and settings selects are native `<select>`; toggles are `<button role="switch">` with visible label left of control; focus ring per D2; skip link to main.
- Contrast: all text pairs in D2 meet 4.5:1 (`--text-2` on `--surface` = 5.9:1). Deltas never rely on color alone (glyph plus sign).
- Reduced motion: D5 fade disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Labels are always visible; no placeholder-as-label anywhere in the settings panel.

### D8. Settings panel scope (Pass 7)
Inline panel holds exactly: Email digest (switch), Profile visibility (select), Timezone (select), and a "Manage account →" link. Anything requiring confirmation (password, delete account, billing) lives on the full settings route, never inline. Saves are per-control and immediate; no Save button.

## Journey Storyboard (Pass 3)
| STEP | USER DOES | USER FEELS | PLAN SPECIFIES? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Lands on /dashboard after login (5s visceral) | "My numbers, instantly" | D1 order, D3 skeletons at 200ms, D2 tabular numerals |
| 2 | Scans deltas | Reassured or alert, not confused | D2 glyph+color deltas, period label |
| 3 | Reads activity (5min behavioral) | In control; nothing jumps | D5 pill, no auto-insert while reading |
| 4 | Flips a setting | Done, trusted | D3 inline "Saved", field-level errors |
| 5 | Loses connection | Informed, not alarmed | D3 live-update row, stale rows kept |
| 6 | First-time user with no posts | Oriented, nudged | D4-a/b, New post as the one action |
| 7 | Returns daily for a year (5yr reflective) | Nothing to notice | D2 calm surface, no decoration to tire of |

## NOT in scope
- Dark mode: deferred until U2 is settled; tokens in D2 are named so a dark set can be added without layout change.
- Charts or sparklines in the stats strip: deltas carry the trend; add only if users ask for history.
- Notification preferences beyond email digest: belongs to the full settings route.
- Activity filtering/search: feed is chronological only; revisit if the feed exceeds a few hundred items per month.

## What already exists
- No DESIGN.md is referenced by the plan and none is in scope; D2 defines provisional tokens. Run `/design-consultation` to make them canonical (U1).
- Tailwind is already the styling layer; D2 tokens map to `theme.extend` rather than a new system.
- Native `<select>`, `<button>` and `role="feed"` cover every control in D1 and D8; no component library needed.

## Design Review (7 passes)

Non-interactive run: each FIX TO 10 below was applied as the recommended option and recorded as D1–D8. Items that need the user's own call are kept open in Pass 7 and the report.

**Step 0 initial rating: 2/10.** The plan said what the backend returns and named four UI blocks, with no hierarchy, states, tokens, viewport or a11y decisions. A 10 for this plan: D1–D8 specified, a DESIGN.md to calibrate against, and mockups approved.

### Pass 1: Information Architecture — 2/10 → 9/10
Before: four blocks listed with no order; the hero would have been the first thing seen. After: D1 fixes first/second/third (numbers, change, action) and the nav flow. Not 10 because the Posts and Audience destinations are named but not designed, so the trunk test is only verifiable for this page.

### Pass 2: Interaction State Coverage — 0/10 → 9/10
Before: no state mentioned. After: D3 covers five states per feature, D4 gives empty states a sentence, an action and context, D5 defines live arrival. Not 10 until copy is proofread against product voice and the skeleton timings are checked on a slow device.

### Pass 3: User Journey & Emotional Arc — 1/10 → 8/10
Before: no user in the plan. After: the storyboard above covers all three time horizons and the first-time path. Not 10 because the arc for a user whose numbers drop (step 2 "alert") has no supportive follow-through beyond the glyph; a 10 would decide whether the dashboard points to a cause.

### Pass 4: AI Slop Risk — 1/10 → 8/10
Mode: OPERATE. Hard rejections hit before fixes: #1 generic card grid as first impression, #7 app UI made of stacked cards. Blacklist hits: #1 gradient background, #3 icons as decoration. All removed by D1 and D2 (hairlines, no cards, no icons, one accent).
Litmus, after fixes: 1 Brand unmistakable: NO, brand is logo-only until U1 resolves. 2 One visual anchor: YES, the stats strip. 3 Scannable by headings: YES, three h2s state the area. 4 One job per section: YES. 5 Cards necessary: NO, and none used. 6 Motion improves hierarchy: YES, D5 single moment. 7 Premium without shadows: YES, none specified.
Capped at 8 because litmus 1 fails until the palette and type voice are owned by a DESIGN.md (U1).

### Pass 5: Design System Alignment — 1/10 → 7/10
No DESIGN.md exists; rated on explicit token and component specification. Before: "cards and icons" only. After: D2 defines type, color, radius, hairline and browser-surface tokens; D7 and D8 fix components to native elements. 7, not higher, because the tokens are provisional and the DESIGN.md gap is unresolved (U1). A 10 cites tokens by path from a DESIGN.md with YAML front matter.

### Pass 6: Responsive & Accessibility — 0/10 → 8/10
Before: nothing. After: D6 gives each viewport its own layout decision rather than stacking, and D7 covers landmarks, keyboard, screen reader announcements, contrast and touch targets. Not 10 until the bottom tab bar is validated against the rest of the app's mobile nav and an RTL check is done on the delta glyph placement.

### Pass 7: Unresolved Design Decisions (unscored)
| DECISION NEEDED | IF DEFERRED, WHAT HAPPENS |
|---|---|
| U1 Canonical brand palette and typeface (D2 is provisional) | Engineer ships D2 as-is; brand stays logo-only and litmus 1 keeps failing |
| U2 Light vs dark from the actual use scene (D2 assumes daylight desk/phone) | Light ships; night-time creators get a bright screen with no alternative |
| U3 Whether the mobile Settings tab should open the inline subset (D8) or the full route | D6 routes to the full page; mobile users lose one-tap toggles |
Resolved in this run: D1–D8 (8 decisions, recommended options applied).
